cues: Add presbyopia, the stiffening lens of age; astigmatism, an unevenly curved cornea; and cataract, a lens gone cloudy.
Focusing on near objects, accommodation, happens when the ciliary muscle contracts, the ligaments slacken, and the elastic lens rounds up.
